name: overlays
description: Trim and clean the footage, pick the best takes, then add overlays.

steps.note: Makes a plan of what to remove; read it and adjust it if needed.
With several clips: review the plan's takes across clips and edit cut-plan.md; never apply here.
Captions before the overlays; with no style given they draw in the profile's caption style and font. Leave them out only when the prompt says no captions.
Light punch-ins on the face (8%), at cuts and on key words, so the talking head is never still. Leave it out only when the prompt says no zoom.
